title: Command Your Morning with Power | Apostle Joshua Selman
paragraphs: Lift your hands wherever you are and bless the name of the Lord. The psalm is declared in Psalm 3:5, "I laid me down and slept. I awake for the Lord sustained me." This morning we rise because mercy woke us. Breath is proof of purpose. Life is evidence of his faithfulness. Give him thanks. Because many slept and did not rise, but you have been remembered for another day of victory. Say, "Father, I thank you. My morning is a covenant sign that your mercy endures forever. Every morning is a prophetic platform.

Is not just the beginning of ours. It's the rebirth of possibilities." The scripture says in Lamentations 3 22-23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. New mercy for a new battle. New grace for a new challenge. New favor for a new assignment. So this morning, we do not rush into activity. We first align with the spirit. Father, thank you because this morning carries your voice. We command the gates of the day to open unto righteousness.

We decree that the sun will favor us. The wind will serve us and the earth will yield increase. This is the day that the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. Psalm 118:4. Beloved, hear me. Mornings are wombs of prophecy. Whatever you plant by words will grow through the hours. Job 38 12 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days? and cause the daypring to know his place. So we command the morning now. Say after me with faith. Oh morning, hear the word of the Lord. I am blessed. I am lifted.

I am favored. I am preserved. Let every cloud of heaviness scatter. LET EVERY WHISPER OF FEAR DISSOLVE. LET EVERY TRACE OF yesterday's failure be buried in the mercy of today. The Lord goes before you as a consuming fire. He makes the crooked places straight. Deuteronomy 9:3. Father, we enthrone you at the beginning of this day. You reign over time and over seasons. You sit upon the circle of the earth. The inhabitants THEREOF ARE AS GRASSHOPPERS before you.

Your wisdom has designed this morning as a portal of encounters. So we LIFT YOUR NAME HIGHER than the noise of our schedules, higher than the pressure of expectations. Be magnified, oh Lord. Psalm 5:3 declares, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Therefore our voices rise like incense. Let every word become light. Let every decree translate into manifestation. Let every confession rewrite atmospheres.

Now we decree by the covenant of Christ this morning. I rise in power. I rise in wisdom. I RISE IN FAVOR. I rise in strength. I rise IN DISCERNMENT. EVERY gate that resisted you yesterday opens now. Every delay you carried INTO THE NIGHT ENDS at dawn. Every embargo ON PROGRESS DISSOLVES under the voice of light because it is written in Isaiah 60:1, "ARISE, SHINE, for thy LIGHT IS COME AND THE GLORY OF the Lord is risen upon thee."

So arise, arise in thinking, arise in planning, arise in confidence, arise in purity, arise in vision, arise in dominion. The Lord says, I am breathing upon your plans this morning. The strength you lacked yesterday returns multiplied. The phone call you've been waiting for WILL COME. THE DOOR you've been knocking on will open. The wisdom for difficult decisions descends like due. Deuteronomy 32:2, "My doctrine shall drop as the rain. My speech shall distill as the dew.

Let the dw of revelation settle upon your mind. You will not walk in confusion. The path of the just shines brighter and brighter." Proverbs 4:18. Every fog of uncertainty clears away. Now your eyes will see opportunities that others overlook. Your ears will hear instructions that bring increase. Now lift your right hand and make these decrees. I decree and declare my steps are ordered by the Lord. I do not walk into traps. I decree and declare my hands are blessed. Whatever I touch prospers. I decree and declare.

I carry favor like fragrance. Men remember me for good. I decree and declare the shield of the Lord is around me. No arrow will find me. I decree and declare the wisdom of heaven governs my decisions. I decree and declare I am the head and not the tail above only and not beneath. Let these decrees echo through the day. Because Proverbs 18 21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue. Speak life. Speak progress. Speak victory. Speak excellence. Your mouth is the pen of a ready writer.

Write success into the hours ahead. Father, we invoke your word over our environment. Let the atmosphere around our homes, offices, and journeys be filled with angelic movement. Psalm 91:1. He shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. We activate those angels now. They go before us into meetings, into markets, into streets, into classrooms. They go ahead of us to remove obstacles. They stand behind us as defense. They surround us as fire.

And now we speak to the spiritual climate of this day. Rain of favor fall. Wind of wisdom blow. Son of righteousness arise with healing in your wings. Let every demonic assignment collapse. Let every demonic gathering scatter. Let every altar speaking against our rising be silenced by the blood. Revelation 12 11. and they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. So by the blood we overcome today. By the blood we secure breakthroughs. By the blood we silence accusers.

By the blood we mark this morning for good news. Beloved, every morning is a seed. If you plant gratitude, you will harvest joy. If you plant prophecy, you will reap destiny. So we plant gratitude right now. Say, "Father, thank you for being my keeper. Thank you for being my lifter. Thank you for being my help in ages past and my hope for years to come. Let thanksgiving rise higher than requests because gratitude multiplies grace. As you go out today, expect divine surprises.

Psalm 68:1 19, "Blessed be the Lord who daily loaded us with benefits." That means there is a package with your name on it. Every sunrise, we now command those benefits to manifest. Opportunities manifest, connections manifest, helpers manifest, resources manifest, favor manifest. The day will not close until your benefit has been delivered. And now I prophesy as one sent someone under the sound of this prayer before midday you will receive a call that changes the story.

Someone will walk into a door that was closed for years. Someone will meet destiny help hidden in plain sight. Someone's name will appear in the heart of kings. Someone's tears will be exchanged for laughter because the Lord says, "I am still the lifter of men." Psalm 75 6-7. For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. He puteth down one and setth up another. You are that another. Today God sets you up. Your steps are directed into favor.

Your path drips with abundance. Your peace is multiplied. Lift both hands now and seal it. Say, "Father, I step into this morning with confidence. I go out with joy and I am led forth with peace. Mountains and hills break forth before me. All creation cooperates with my destiny. No weapon formed against me will prosper. The lines are falling onto me in pleasant places. I have a goodly heritage." Psalm 118:17, I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. You will live to testify.

You will return in the evening with songs of victory. You will become a living proof that God still answers morning prayers. Lift your voice in thanksgiving. The breath in your lungs this morning is proof that God has not finished with you. Say, "Father, thank you for the gift of another sunrise for new chances, new mercy, new favor." Psalm 143:8, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning, for in thee do I trust." So Lord, let every heart here hear your loving kindness before this day ends.

Now we decree the day blessed. Every schedule, every meeting, every phone call becomes a channel of favor. You will not step into traps disguised as opportunities. You will step into opportunities disguised as interruptions. Romans 8 28. All things work together for good to them that love God. Today all things seen and unseen work for your good. Father, we sanctify the hours ahead. Let the morning bring direction. The afternoon produce results and the evening end in testimony.

Every moment between now and nightfall carries angelic supervision. Let mercy be your companion. Let wisdom be your counselor. Let peace be your atmosphere. Say after me with conviction, I decree and declare the heavens over me are open. I decree and declare my hands are anointed for productivity. I decree and declare my eyes will see divine opportunities. I decree and declare I walk in supernatural favor. I decree and declare no evil shall befall me nor my family.

I decree and declare today deliver us what God wrote concerning me. Psalm 90 17. Let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us and establish thou the work of our hands. Beauty means grace that removes struggle. Establishment means permanence of success. So Lord, establish every good work represented here. Turn simple effort into extraordinary results. Let proposals be approved, exams be passed, sales be multiplied, visions be remembered. And now, Father, as the sun rises, rise within your people.

Let boldness replace fear. Let clarity silence confusion. LET JOY swallow anxiety. Psalm 30:5. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Joy has come. This morning is the end of the night season. Someone hearing me. The Lord says, "Before this day closes, there shall be a sign that I am mindful of you. Expect the unexpected, an email, a message, a handshake that shifts your story." Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight.

Therefore, crooked systems align, complicated matters simplify, delayed approvals accelerate. Lift your hands high and worship. Say, "Father, thank you. I believe your word. I receive your grace. I walk in victory." Psalm 118:23. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. Your testimony today will be marvelous. You will end the day saying, "The Lord has done great things for me." And now the benediction. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May his face shine upon you and grant you peace.

May your going out and coming in be secured. May strength never depart from your spirit. May laughter fill your house. May everything that concerns you bear the mark of divine favor. The Lord crowns your morning with glory, your afternoon with fruitfulness, and your evening with rest. You will lie down tonight in peace saying surely goodness and mercy have followed me all day long in Jesus' name. Amen.
practice: Strength sometimes looks like restraint. Where might you need the power to listen to the end of a sentence before deciding what to say back?
